definitions.famine_loss: At least one native Famine feared ... lost notification.
definitions.actual_landing: Own Settlers exists before/after a disembark action, and transported changes true to false.
definitions.landed_settler_lost_before_city: A landed Settlers disappears in a later observed transition before any visible new own city; does not count consumption in city founding.
definitions.landed_settler_lost_at_next_end_turn: Above loss occurs at the first END_TURN following its landing.
definitions.all_settlers_lost_before_city: Observed own Settlers count changes positive to zero before any visible new own city.
definitions.settler_restored_after_total_loss: After the first total loss, a subsequent observed state contains an own Settlers.
definitions.population_block: Native notification contains can't build Settlers yet.
definitions.population_block_with_next_decision: At least one such warning is followed by another recorded decision, including a possible no-submission decision.
definitions.post_total_loss: Decisions strictly after the transition first losing all Settlers; loss action is excluded; API count includes correction.
